summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K reporting four unsecured demand promissory notes totaling $1,650,000 issued to NLabs Inc., a principal stockholder and affiliate of the CEO, on September 29, 2026. Interest accrues at 10% annually, payable at maturity, with principal and interest due on the earlier of December 31, 2026, or demand; prepayment is permitted without penalty. Proceeds fund working capital. The filing includes the note form as Exhibit 4.1 under Items 1.01 and 2.03; no board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. This is a related-party financing, not a change-of-control or capital-markets special situation. Watch for liquidity signals and potential dilution if the notes are not repaid.
